Criteria for Approval:
● Member is NOT receiving hemodialysis*; AND
● Documentation (e.g., progress note, laboratory report) of hemoglobin (Hgb) < 10 g/dL in the past 90 days; AND
● Prescribed for one of the following diagnoses:
○ Anemia associated with chronic renal failure; OR
○ Anemia associated with kidney transplantation; OR
○ Treatment of chemotherapy-induced anemia for non-myeloid malignancies.

Renewal Criteria:
● Documentation (e.g., progress note, laboratory report) of response to therapy.
